name: Lords of Wrestling (debut card)
no_appearances_reason: The three worked matches stage only unminted personas (Mark Bagwell vs. The Super American, the Sicilians vs. the Midnight Rockers, the Serbian Terrorist vs. Jeremy Peyton); no character records were minted per the depth-is-an-annotation rule -- the results and commentary live in the page text.
notes: The fed's own three-match debut show, its only full card ever to surface in the held record: 'Bad Boy' Mark Bagwell defeats The Super American by submission (Boston Crab); the Midnight Rockers defeat the Sicilians by pinfall after a double dropkick; Jeremy Peyton defeats the Serbian Terrorist by pinfall (Superkick) despite manager interference. The show closes on a teaser for the following week's card and an announced ASWF Heavyweight Title tournament that this corpus never shows being run.
